//: Dedicated tsconfig for the Playwright suite. web/tsconfig.json has rootDir './' and covers only web/, so e2e/ sat outside every TypeScript project — which is why type-aware ESLint rules could not run over it. Mirrors web/tsconfig.json (strict, DOM libs for page.evaluate callbacks). @types/node is required: helpers.ts and playwright.config.ts both read process.env, and the e2e suite is type-checked by its own tsconfig.
